posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal shared the first photo of baby son Vihaan, sending fans into a frenzy as the new parents settle into family life.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Fresh off Los Angeles declaring a 'Diljit Dosanjh Day,' the global superstar's San Francisco show made headlines, while his film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' posted a stunning second-weekend jump at the box office.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The 'Alpha' trailer dropped to roaring response ahead of its July 3 release, as Alia gears up for an action-packed spell that also includes 'Love And War' with Ranbir and Vicky.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: PeeCee confirmed a collaboration with Angelina Jolie and is busy filming SS Rajamouli's 'Varanasi' with Mahesh Babu, cementing her standing as a true global star.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Anticipation builds for SRK's 'King,' eyeing a December release, with fresh buzz that the action spectacle could be split into two parts.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Bebo's thriller 'Daayra' with Prithviraj Sukumaran locked a September 18 release, and she joined the cast and crew to celebrate 25 years of 'Lagaan.'

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: The teaser for 'Eetha' stunned fans, with Shraddha playing legendary tamasha artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar in what's being called a career-defining role, out August 28.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, Deepika continues to juggle a packed slate, including SRK's 'King' and Allu Arjun's 'Raaka.'

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer is riding the historic run of 'Dhurandhar,' now among the highest-grossing Indian films ever, even as he turns producer with the zombie actioner 'Pralay.'

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: The OG Queen of Cannes recreated her iconic ivory saree look at the festival, winning hearts with a bold sindoor statement that went viral worldwide.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is winning over audiences in 'Cocktail 2' alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon, as the romantic comedy opens to a strong box office start.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Sam's home production 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' hit theatres to positive reviews, even as buzz swirls about a new personal milestone with husband Raj Nidimoru.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: The Icon Star's ambitious sci-fi saga with director Atlee, titled 'Raaka,' continues building hype with its fierce first look and a star-studded female cast.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' is on a box office rampage, crossing Rs 200 crore gross and earning praise from peers for his gritty body transformation.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR gears up for his big Bollywood debut in YRF's 'War 2' alongside Hrithik Roshan, while his Prashanth Neel epic 'Dragon' builds anticipation for 2027.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars opposite Ram Charan in the blockbuster 'Peddi,' marking a major pan-India outing as the rural sports drama dominates the box office.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya stays in the spotlight with a busy slate of projects and brand collaborations, continuing her run as one of the industry's most-watched young stars.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara joins the YRF Spy Universe with 'War 2,' starring opposite Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in one of the year's most anticipated action tentpoles.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik headlines YRF's 'War 2' before stepping behind the camera for his directorial debut with the long-awaited superhero saga 'Krrish 4.'

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun balances a packed lineup of big-ticket projects, keeping fans guessing about his next release as he juggles action and family entertainers.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: The melody queen kicks off her global 'Unstoppable' world tour this September, with arena dates across the US and Canada including Oakland and Los Angeles.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: The Mozart of Madras makes his Arabic cinema debut with the 'Baab' soundtrack and lines up a packed concert calendar, including US symphony dates this July.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Fresh off a blockbuster political debut as his TVK party swept to a historic showing in Tamil Nadu, Vijay's swan-song film 'Jana Nayagan' nears its long-awaited release.
